description: This file contains PHP classes that compile Smarty template functions and handle their lifecycle, including parsing, code generation, and cache management.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Function
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling Smarty {function} tags into PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Functionclose
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling Smarty {/function} tags and finalizing function code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {function} or {/function} tag into executable PHP code.

methods.name: removeNocache
methods.description: Removes nocache code segments from compiled template code.
